name: npm-dependency-dashboard
description: Audit, review, upgrade, and clean npm or pnpm dependencies safely inside VS Code.
author: Azzam Aldulaylan

untrustedWorkspaces.description: This extension reads .npmrc and can run npm install, which executes code from the workspace. It stays disabled until the workspace is trusted.

dependencyDashboard.registry.useProjectN.description: Read the registry from the project's .npmrc. Values containing ${ are always rejected. Turn this off to use only your user-level .npmrc.

dependencyDashboard.upgrade.ignoreScript.description: Pass --ignore-scripts when upgrading, so package lifecycle scripts don't run.

dependencyDashboard.upgrade.verification.description: Package.json script names to run after an install as explicit upgrade verification (for example test, build, or typecheck). No scripts run by default.

dependencyDashboard.cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long cached dependency data stays fresh before it's rescanned, in minutes. 0 means always revalidate.

dependencyDashboard.debug.performance.description: Log local Dependency Dashboard performance measurements to the extension and webview developer consoles. No telemetry is sent.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p src/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p webview/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:real-projects && npm run test:extension-host
scripts.benchmark:performance: npm run pretest && npm run build:core && node scripts/performance/benchmark.mjs
scripts.benchmark:actions: npm run pretest && npm run build:core && node scripts/performance/action-benchmark.mjs
scripts.benchmark:workspace-reads: npm run pretest && npm run build:core && node scripts/performance/workspace-read-benchmark.mjs
